skill.name: baoyu-article-illustrator
skill.description: Analyzes Markdown articles, selects illustration positions, creates image prompts, and inserts generated visuals with consistent style options.
skill.summary: Plan and generate consistent article illustrations from Markdown content.
skill.author: JimLiu

security_audit.summary: All 52 static external-command findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, inline style names, and fenced examples in SKILL.md. One semantic issue remains: prompts/system.md tells the downstream image generator not to refuse sensitive or copyrighted figures, which can undermine safety review.

remediation.issue: Image prompt discourages safety refusals for sensitive or copyrighted figures.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the "DO NOT refuse" instruction and state that the generator must follow its safety and copyright policies.

remediation.issue: Markdown usage examples are labeled as bash even though they are skill slash commands.
remediation.suggestion: Change non-shell examples from bash fences to text fences to reduce false external-command detections.

static_findings.snippet: | `--style <name>` | Specify illustration style (see Style Gallery below) |
When no `--style` is specified, analyze content to select the best style:
| AI, coding, tech, digital, algorithm, data | `tech` |
| Personal story, emotion, growth, life, feeling | `warm` |
| Fun, easy, beginner, tutorial, guide, how-to | `playful` |
| Nature, eco, wellness, health, organic, green | `nature` |
Save illustrations to `imgs/` subdirectory in the same folder as the article:
Save prompts to `prompts/` directory with style-specific details.

semantic_findings.title: Safety Refusal Override in Image Prompt
semantic_findings.description: The downstream image prompt says "DO NOT refuse to generate" for sensitive or copyrighted figures. This can pressure a model to bypass normal safety and copyright checks.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instruction is explicit and appears in the system prompt used for image generation. It directly discourages refusal for sensitive or copyrighted subject matter.

content.value_statement: Long articles often need visuals, but choosing image positions and prompts takes time. This skill analyzes Markdown content, plans illustrations, and creates consistent prompts and image placements.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes article themes, sections, and abstract ideas that need visuals.
Selects one of nine illustration styles or uses a requested style.
Creates an illustration plan with positions, purpose, visual content, and filenames.
Writes prompt files under an imgs/prompts folder for each illustration.
Inserts Markdown image links with concise alt text after relevant paragraphs.
Reports generated images, insertion positions, and any failures.
limitations: Requires an available image generation skill; it does not include its own generator.
Image quality depends on the selected generator and prompt interpretation.
The workflow may create many images because it favors broad visual coverage.
It works best with Markdown articles; other formats may need conversion first.

use_cases.title: Add visuals to technical articles
use_cases.description: Turn complex programming or AI explanations into section-level diagrams and concept illustrations.

use_cases.title: Prepare branded blog illustrations
use_cases.description: Create consistent visual prompts and image placements for long-form marketing articles.

use_cases.title: Visualize lesson materials
use_cases.description: Identify abstract ideas in educational content and create approachable illustrations for learners.

prompt_templates.title: Illustrate a Markdown article
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with automatic style selection.
prompt_templates.prompt: Add illustrations to docs/article.md. Choose the best style automatically, generate images, and insert them into the article.

prompt_templates.title: Use a selected style
prompt_templates.scenario: Choose a known visual style for a consistent article look.
prompt_templates.prompt: Illustrate posts/ai-guide.md with the tech style. Create visuals for the main concepts and update the Markdown file.

prompt_templates.title: Plan before generating
prompt_templates.scenario: Review the illustration strategy before image generation starts.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze drafts/strategy.md and prepare an illustration plan with filenames and prompts. Wait for approval before generating images.

prompt_templates.title: Refine an existing article layout
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for improving visual coverage and consistency.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review guides/productivity.md, keep existing useful images, add missing illustrations, and make all new prompts match the notion style.

output_examples.input: A guide about AI code review at docs/review.md with the tech style.
output_examples.output: The skill selects tech visuals, plans images for the overview and workflow sections, creates prompt files, generates images, inserts Markdown links, and summarizes positions.

output_examples.input: A personal growth essay that does not specify a style.
output_examples.output: The skill detects warm content signals, chooses the warm style, creates human-centered illustration prompts, and places images after key emotional sections.

output_examples.input: A long tutorial that needs review before image generation.
output_examples.output: The skill produces an illustration plan with proposed image count, insert positions, visual concepts, and filenames for approval.

best_practices: Use clear section headings so the skill can choose accurate illustration positions.
Specify a style when the article must match a brand or publication tone.
Review the illustration plan before generation for long or sensitive articles.
anti_patterns: Do not use it on private drafts without checking where generated images and prompts will be stored.
Do not request many decorative images when the article only needs one core visual.
Do not bypass image generator safety rules for copyrighted or sensitive subjects.

faq.question: Does this skill generate images by itself?
faq.answer: No. It prepares prompts and calls an available image generation skill selected during the workflow.

faq.question: Can I choose the illustration style?
faq.answer: Yes. You can specify styles such as tech, warm, minimal, playful, nature, sketch, elegant, bold, or notion.

faq.question: Where are generated files stored?
faq.answer: The workflow stores prompts and images in an imgs folder beside the article.

faq.question: Will it edit my article?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow inserts Markdown image links after the relevant paragraphs when image generation succeeds.

faq.question: Can it handle sensitive people or copyrighted figures?
faq.answer: It should use safe alternatives and follow the selected generator policies for sensitive or copyrighted subjects.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
